run_generate_dummy_data: run the script to generate dummy GTZAN music speech WAV data for testing
run_generate_data_with_tfsd_dir: run the script with a custom tfds_dir flag to generate dummy data in a specified directory
test_generate_data: test the _generate_data function that creates a random WAV file and copies it to the output directory
test_output_dir: test the _output_dir function that returns the dummy data path under audio/gtzan_music_speech
test_main: test the main entry point that invokes _generate_data via absl.app.run
